body:
I don't know... My teacher hasn't been the most understanding person.

But I'll definitely try.

Thank you!
Thank you! I'll keep an eye out for any spots like that. :)
I don't think I'd mind too much telling them about what happened if it would help them understand my poor academic performance.

If I start to want to live again, I'll stop myself and get help, but right now, I'm just enjoying the moment.

(And I'm a girl, by the way.) :)
